cases.label: Multi-Hit Attack String (M1 Combo, Weapon Moveset)
required_tools_ordered: parallax anim dossier new (Schema 2 measured phases + private 3det ref frames)
parallax anim design <Set> (Owner Stop 1: cuts, heights, bodies, frames, links: pose|blend, zero cousins)
parallax anim block <Move> --sheet (Owner Stop 2: poses-first held at timing)
author from scratch (spring engine, 60 fps KeyframeSequence)
parallax anim sheet (open keys/ at full size)
parallax anim picks (4-12 real-time player-cam GIFs, Owner Pick)

v4_upgrade_tools.when_present: Auto-activates as mandatory orchestrator once V4 A3 lands on main.

forbidden_tools.why: Designing combo moves one-by-one without a set design produces 'cousin' animations that are too similar.
Jumping straight to dense motion without blocked poses skips the foundational shape-language check.
Splicing catalog poses for combat animations produces unoriginal motion that fails the originality rule.
CurveAnimation (30 Hz) for 60 fps strikes loses half the frames and reads as choppy.

cases.capability_policy: Full-capability, case-matched execution (NEVER artificially minimal): use the ENTIRE pipeline whenever the piece benefits from it; `required_tools_ordered` is the quality floor, extra non-forbidden pipeline tools are ALWAYS allowed, `forbidden_tools` blocks ONLY tools that degrade this case, and edge-case skips require `--skip-tool <tool> --why "<reason>"` logged to `.verify/parallax_session.json`.
examples: build a 5-hit M1 sword combo string with set design and blocking passes
create a full katana moveset with chain links and no cousin animations
make a multi-hit attack sequence for a character's combat moveset

cases.label: Walk, Run, Sprint, Idle, Wallrun, Air Loop

Missing remote <Name>Upper replication means the upper body layer is not replicated to other clients.
